title: Claude Code PreToolUse hook output — codex strict variant
description: Strict-subset version of ../pretooluse.schema.json, shaped for OpenAI strict structured output (codex 'exec --output-schema', and also accepted by claude '--json-schema'). Strict mode rules: every property is listed in 'required', every object is closed, and arbitrary-keys objects are forbidden. So optional fields are typed nullable (the model emits null when not applicable — strip null-valued keys before feeding the result to a hook), and the open-object 'updatedInput' field from the full schema is omitted entirely. Use the full ../pretooluse.schema.json for reference or with claude when you need updatedInput.

hookEventName.description: Discriminator; must match the firing event.

permissionDecision.description: allow: skip the permission prompt. deny: block the call. ask: prompt the user. defer: exit gracefully so the call can resume later. Across stacked hooks the precedence is deny > defer > ask > allow.

permissionDecisionReason.description: For deny: shown to Claude. For allow/ask: shown to the user. null when not applicable — strip null keys before use. Always provide a string when permissionDecision is deny.

additionalContext.description: Extra context delivered to Claude alongside the tool result, or null when none — strip null keys before use.
